text: dsh-side-branch 为 DSH 网页客户端提供右侧栏只读追问分支。用户可引用主会话中的文字提问，也可从输入框旁的快速入口打开面板；回答和后续问题留在侧枝会话中。插件从主会话已完成的回合创建分支，并支持独立选择模型和推理强度、查看继承内容及流式接收回答。适合想围绕当前对话补充提问、又希望主会话保持原样的 DSH 用户。安装后需重启 DSH。

dsh-side-branch adds a read-only follow-up panel to the DSH web client. Quote text from the main session or open it from a quick-entry button. The side branch starts with completed main-session turns, keeps its answers separate, and supports a separate model choice and streamed replies.
想在 DSH 主会话旁边开一个独立的追问面板
划选对话里的一段文字后直接针对它提问
让侧边提问的回答不要进入主会话上下文
我想用不同于主会话的模型继续问一个小问题
查看侧枝回答时它继承了主会话哪些已完成内容
有没有能边生成边显示侧边栏回答的方式
Ask a follow-up about selected text without adding it to my main conversation
Open a separate DSH sidebar chat while my main session keeps running
dsh-side-branch 的功能「引用选中文字提问」：用户在主会话中选中文字后点击浮动入口，插件把引用送入侧枝面板作为问题上下文；该问答保留在独立分支中。
dsh-side-branch 的功能「同步主会话已完成回合」：每次创建或重建侧枝时，插件从主会话事件中取最后一个已完成回合之前的内容作为种子，并保留侧枝自己的问答历史。
dsh-side-branch 的功能「为侧枝单独选模型」：面板提供模型和 reasoning effort 选择；发送时将所选项交给宿主，未指定模型时则跟随主会话当前模型。
dsh-side-branch 的功能「快速打开侧枝面板」：主会话输入框旁的快速入口可以打开右侧面板；设置中的 quickEntry 开关可隐藏这个入口。

- Ask about the current conversation without adding a token to it.
- Point the branch at a cheaper model while the main session keeps the expensive one.
- Let a long task keep running, and ask something unrelated on the side.

text: dsh-side-branch README · What makes it different：**The answer never comes back.** The host never writes the branch's output into the parent session. What you ask in the branch stays in the branch — the main agent will not suddenly "know" what you discussed on the side.

dsh-side-branch README · What makes it different：**It cannot touch your files.** Read-only is enforced when a tool is *called*, not by hiding tools from the prompt. `ctx.tools.guard()` passes six side-effect-free tools (`read`, `glob`, `grep`, `web_search`, `web_fetch`, `lsp`) and refuses everything else. Because the tools stay in the prompt, the branch's prompt prefix is byte-identical to the main session's, so it keeps hitting the parent's prefix cache — measured 97%–98%, which is what makes a side question nearly free. Why it works this way, and what it costs, is in [`docs/TECHNICAL.md`](docs/TECHNICAL.md).

dsh-side-branch README · What makes it different：**It follows the main session.** Every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the main session's latest settled turns and replays the branch's own earlier questions and answers into it. A turn the main session just finished is already visible; something you asked three rounds ago is still remembered.

**You can inspect what it was given.** Expand *Inherited from the main session* to see, turn by turn, what the branch actually received — plus the preamble injected into its prompt, verbatim.

dsh-side-branch README · npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-side-branch

dsh-side-branch README · or straight from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:wucl12/dsh-side-branch
```

Use the profile you actually run (`web`, `desktop`, …). **Then restart DSH** — client plugins load at startup, and refreshing the browser is not enough.

Prerequisites: Node.js ≥ 20, and `pnpm` on your `PATH` (`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm).

Also available from a marketplace — [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) and the [awesome-dsh-plugin catalog](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) both list it.

dsh-side-branch README · or straight from GitHub：> 🤖 **Prompt for AI agents:** if you are the agent installing this plugin or reading its source, read [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) first — it carries the hard constraints, the architecture, and the installation guide.

dsh-side-branch README · How to use：1. **Ask via selection:** select text in the main session and click the pop-up **Quote and ask**. The branch opens in the right panel with the passage quoted. That passage is recorded with the round as a collapsible quote block, and the composer's quote slot clears itself so the next question starts clean.
2. **Quick entry:** the `↗` button to the right of the main session's input opens the panel directly (can be disabled in settings).
3. **Independent settings:** inside the panel you can give the current branch its own model and reasoning effort, without following the main session.

dsh-side-branch README · Compatibility：The version-dependent seams (the archive gate, `unarchiveSession`) are feature-detected at runtime rather than compared by version number, which is why one published version serves all four. Details in [`docs/TECHNICAL.md`](docs/TECHNICAL.md).

dsh-side-branch README · Compatibility：The quote entry added in `0.2.2` needs the conversation-surface markers DSH renders around a session's body (`[data-conversation-content]`, or `[data-conversation-scroll]` on older hosts). On a host that renders neither, the entry stays hidden rather than guessing — everything else in the plugin is unaffected.

dsh-side-branch README · Security & limitations：* **Read-only boundaries:** "read-only" here means **no system side effects** (no writing files, no running commands). `web_fetch` / `web_search` still have network access, and `read` can read any file the process can. The allowlist is hardcoded and cannot be relaxed through settings.
* **What the branch can see:** it is rebuilt from the main session's **latest settled turns**, so a turn the main session has finished follows along automatically. A turn it **has not finished yet** is not visible (the cut is the last `turn/end`) — but **quoting it by hand is unaffected**: the limit is on seeing it automatically, not on being able to quote it.
* **Rebuilds leave session records:** each rebuild creates a new side-session record, and the platform has **no API to delete a session**, so records accumulate. They are reclaimed by an orphan sweep at plugin startup, which logs what it deleted. While two instances share the same `DSH_HOME` and run at once, that sweep skips entirely — a second DSH never has its live branches deleted.

dsh-side-branch README · How it compares：Side-chat plugins here differ mainly in where the answer ends up and what the side session is allowed to do.

| Where the answer ends up | A separate branch; the host never writes it back | A separate DSH session | **The current conversation** — the selection is sent as a user message |
| Tool access of the side session | Six side-effect-free tools; writes refused when called | Not stated in its README | Same session, so the full tool set |
| Sees the main session's newest settled turns | Every follow-up (forced rebuild) | Optional — full inherit / summarize / truncate | Yes — it is the same session |
| Nested follow-ups / follow-up history tree | No | Yes | No |
| Runtime dependencies | none | none (since 1.0.0) | — |

dsh-side-branch README · How this was built：This plugin is a dogfooding result: the entire codebase — host half, client half, and the self-checks under `scripts/` — was written by DSH itself, working against the contracts in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). No line of code was written by hand.

dsh-side-branch README · How this was built：The human part was the workflow around it: choosing what to build, setting the direction, reviewing each plan before it was carried out, and verifying the result by hand in a real session. When that verification found something wrong, it went back as a requirement — which is how the archive-gate fix, the multi-segment answer bug and the re-fork design were found.
